blocks.text: Ms. Seema ChouhanAssociate ProfessorDepartment of Electronics and Telecommunication EngineeringInstitute of Engineering and Technology (IET), Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya, Indore
Ph.D. (Pursuing) – Department of Electrical Engineering, IIT Indore, under the Next-Generation Semiconductor Chip Design and AI Computing Systems (NSDCS) Laboratory.
M.E. in Digital Electronics – Ujjain Engineering College (UEC), Ujjain, 2017.
B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering – Government Engineering College, Ujjain, 2006.

Joined the Institute of Engineering and Technology (IET), Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya, Indore, on 22 August 2007 and is currently serving as an Associate Professor in the Department of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering.
Hardware security and secure memory architectures
Emerging memory-centric architectures for AI applications

The current Ph.D. research work is being carried out at IIT Indore in the NSDCS Laboratory, with a focus on developing secure and energy-efficient SRAM-based In-Memory Computing architectures for emerging AI and VLSI applications.
